newsitem.title: USA: ITT says will consider Hilton bid.
newsitem.headline: ITT says will consider Hilton bid.

text.p: ITT Corp said Wednesday it will consider a new $8.3 billion takeover bid submitted by Hilton Hotels Corp "in due course".
"The ITT board will exercise its fiduciary responsibility and consider the offer in due course," spokesman Jim Gallagher said.
Hilton earlier raised its seven-month-old $55 per share bid for ITT to $70 per share.
ITT had repeatedly rejected the previous offer and last month unveiled a massive restructuring that includes a plan to break the company into three pieces and buy back $2.1 billion in stock.
Shares of ITT jumped 2-13/16 to 65-3/4 in early trade.
